artworks.title: Le modèle honnête
artworks.artist: Jean-Michel Moreau and Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: There is a detailed drawing of multiple figures in a richly decorated room. The central figure is a woman seated on a raised platform with her upper body and a portion of her legs exposed. She appears to be interacting with two other figures: one assisting her with draping fabric, while the other is seated in front of a large easel. The seated figure is likely an artist. The woman has soft facial features and styled hair, covered by a cloth. The other figures are dressed in elaborate 18th-century fashion. The room has patterned curtains, framed artwork, an ornate chair and screen, a large rug, detailed moldings, and various paintings on the walls. A partially open window with heavy drapes allows light into the room.

artworks.title: Le modèle honnête
artworks.artist: Jean-Michel Moreau and Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on a cushioned platform, with her upper body exposed and her legs wrapped in fabric. She has a contemplative expression, resting her head on her hand. Her hair is styled up. Another person leans towards her, gesturing as if in conversation, dressed in historical clothing. A third person stands nearby offering support. The room is lavishly decorated with draperies, paintings, and a large ornate mirror reflecting the scene, suggesting a studio or a well-furnished room. A canvas on an easel shows a figure resembling the woman. The room has classical detailing in furniture and decor, including a patterned rug and decorative walls.

artworks.title: Le Rendez-vous
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals from the waist up, positioned closely together. The person on the left is reclined slightly backward and looking upward. They wear a white cap and light-colored clothing with loose fabric around the neckline. The person on the right leans towards them, with short, curly brown hair and distinct facial features. He wears a brown garment with a white collar and a red jacket draped over his shoulders. His hand reaches out towards the other person. The background shows a shelf with simple items such as a pitcher and a lit candle.

artworks.title: Rose et Colas
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic interior setting. The drawing depicts an interior scene with a focus on domestic and rural life. The room features a ladder leading up to a loft area with a haystack. In the foreground, there is a spinning wheel next to a wooden chair draped with fabric, and a woven basket on the floor. On the right, the space under a staircase is used to store a wooden barrel and various agricultural produce including a cabbage. The architectural details, such as wooden beams and an open doorway, contribute to the rustic ambiance. The decoration on the bottom of the image includes ornate scrollwork framing a vacant oval. The drawing provides a rich portrayal of pastoral life, with detailed texture work that emphasizes the homely character of the scene.

artworks.title: La Sentinelle en défaut
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dimly lit room with draped beds. The room has hanging drapes and garments around three distinct beds in a rustic, wooden interior. At the center, there is a scene with two figures on a bed, one of whom appears to be holding something up while the other sits closely. The texture and shading in the drawing create depth and warmth, focusing attention on the central interaction. Objects like a stool with clothes and a small container are scattered around the room, adding to the domestic atmosphere.

artworks.title: La Sentinelle en défaut
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a dimly lit bedroom. The image shows a room with two beds; one on the left with drawn curtains and a figure reclined and asleep, and another to the right where two figures are engaged in an interaction. A dim light source illuminates the scene, casting shadows across the room. The central focus is on the two figures on the right sitting on the edge of a bed with draped textiles around them.

artworks.title: La soiree des Thuileries
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: The image shows two people sitting outside. The woman is standing to the left, leaning forward with one foot on an overturned chair, while the man is reclined in a chair with his arm over the backrest. The woman has elegant curled hair and wears a decorative hat, with delicate facial features and intricate clothing. The man wears clothing typical of 18th-century fashion. A small dog sits nearby. They are in front of a large stone structure, possibly a pedestal with a sculpture on top. The background includes trimmed hedges, tall trees, and cloudy skies, suggesting a formal garden setting.

artworks.title: La soiree des Thuileries
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a woman and a man, seated outdoors. The woman is dressed elegantly in 18th-century fashion, with a large hairstyle and ornate dress. She holds a closed fan. The man is reclined comfortably, looking at the woman. They are accompanied by a small dog. The background features a well-kept garden, a large statue on a pedestal, and a moonlit sky with scattered clouds.

artworks.title: Le léger vêtement
artworks.description: This image displays a young woman depicted from the waist up within an oval frame. She is seated with her right arm resting on a surface, supporting her head with her hand. Her serene facial expression features delicate features, including a slightly smiling mouth and high-arched eyebrows. Her hair is styled with curls framing her face and decorated with small floral ornaments. She wears a gown with a low neckline and ruffled sleeves, accessorized with a string of beads around her neck. In her left hand, she holds a small bouquet of flowers. The background features a subtle pattern and a cluster of flowers, adding to the portrait's elegant and decorative ambiance.

artworks.title: La Gaieté de Silène
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a classical style. The central figure is seated, slightly leaning back, with the other two reclining beside and behind. The central figure has curly hair and a wide face with a wreath. The figure on the left is semi-reclined with long hair, and the figure on the right has curly hair. They are wearing draped cloths and head adornments. An ornate jug or vessel is nearby. The scene is surrounded by a border with grapevines and foliage. In the background, there are trees and possibly hilly terrain. The engraving is enclosed by rectangular frames with vine motifs and inscriptions in French.

artworks.title: La promenade au Jardin Turc
artworks.artist: Jean-Pierre-Marie Jazet after Jean Joseph Bastier de Bez
artworks.description: The image displays a street scene with a grand building on the left, featuring tall windows and a sloping roof. Several people are depicted along the street, dressed in historical attire, engaged in various activities. In the foreground, a crowd of individuals in colorful clothing is visible, contrasting with the building's muted tones. Further back, a terrace with more people is partially obscured by railings and foliage. The background shows trees and a blue sky with subtle clouds. Softly painted trees create a gentle texture against the sky. The scene's color palette includes muted blues and greens, brightened by colorful attire. The overall impression is lively yet serene, with a sense of movement in the urban setting.

artworks.title: Le cocarde nationale
artworks.description: Two smooth-faced, smiling people embrace and look at us in a room a fireplace, chairs, and a table in this vertical, colored etching and aquatint. The couple are in the center of the composition. To the right in that pair, one person sits in a wood chair with an upholstered seat and the other stands. Both people have pale skin with rosy cheeks, wide-set, large brown eyes, delicate noses and mouths, and pointed chins. The seated person is dressed in a military uniform with a white vest, a rose-pink coat, white, knee-length britches, white stockings, and black shoes with silver buckles. His ankles are crossed and the britches trimmed with powder-blue at the knees. A sword hangs from his left hip, to our right. He has dark gray, curly hair under a bicorn hat, which has a blue and dark pink badge on the front and blue and white feathers issuing from the top. The woman stands close to him, and he rests the hand we can see on her waist. Her puffy, ash-blond hair curls along her shoulders and falls down her back. Her white bodice is cut low across an ample bosom, and pin ribbons are tied around the upper arm we can see. She wears a pale, sky-blue, voluminous skirt. She holds the seated person’s chin with one hand and touches the hat with the other. A long stringed instrument lies across the seat and armrest of a chair just behind her. A table next to that, along the left edge of the sheet, holds a white bottle and piece of cloth, perhaps a lacy cap. A mantle with a bellows and a screen is to the right of and behind the man. A gold-colored ormolu clock sits on the mantle and a gold double candle sconce hangs to the left on molding that frames the fireplace. More furniture, perhaps a dresser, is in the background in front of a sable-brown wall.

artworks.title: Sweet resistance (La douce resistance)
artworks.description: This print shows two people standing and embracing. The woman on the left is leaning slightly backward, while the man on the right leans toward her, holding her close. She looks at him through almost-closed eyes. They both have pale skin and curled gray hair, although hers is longer, cascading down her back. She is wearing a pale blue dress with a wide neck, puffed sleeves, and a bright pink skirt, accentuated with a blue ribbon tied around her waist. The man is wearing a light blue coat over a high-collared white shirt, with fitted, knee-length blue breeches and stockings. They are in a room with muted brown drapery hanging on the right over what looks like a bed with the blanket and ruffled sheets partially off. To the side, in front of the bed, there is a plush red chair with a black hat and cloak or jacket draped over it. On the left there is a white door behind the two people that is slightly ajar. Below the print is a line of text.

artworks.title: It was pulled today (On la tire aujourd'hui)
artworks.description: A man and woman look at each other near a door as a second woman sits at a dressing table in this vertical, colored print. All three people have pale skin. The man’s body faces the partially open door, which is to our left, but he turns to look and smile at the woman embracing him from behind. He has chin-length gray hair and wears a black, brimmed hat, a high-collared, white shirt with a frilly cravat, a baby-blue vest, a tan, shin-length jacket, peach-colored, knee-length breeches, white stockings, and black shoes. He holds four papers with writing and signatures down by his right side, to our left. The woman behind him reaches one hand gently for the papers as she wraps the other around his other arm. She has long, brown hair and wears a high, wide-brimmed straw bonnet piled with carnation-pink bows. Her dress has a teal-blue bodice over a white, elbow-length shirt, which is pulled partially down her chest to reveal one pale pink nipple. A powder-blue shoe pokes out from her long, voluminous silvery-blue skirt. To the right and farther into the room, the woman at the table holds both hands to a cap on her long brown hair as she looks at us and smiles faintly. Her loose white gown is cinched at the waist and falls to her ankles. The bodice has a low neckline, and the sleeves are rolled up to her elbows. She wears white stockings and backless pink slippers with pointed toes. On the table are a round box with a white poof with a handle, scissors, a brown ribbon, and a rectangular brown object, presumably a mirror.  A blue garment hangs over the arm of the chair we can see. Light falls on the couple near the door and the rest of the room is in shadow. Celestial-blue curtains fall in front of a bed behind the seated woman. Text in the margin below the image reads, “ON LA TIRE AUJOURD'HUI.” Much smaller, cursive printed text under the left corner reads “L. Boilly pinx,” and under the right corner, “Salv. Tresca Sculpt.”

artworks.title: Que n'y est-il encore?
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in the center. She is slightly turned to her left, with her gaze directed upwards. The woman has long, wavy dark hair with a red ribbon tied around her head. She is wearing a light-colored blouse, a full beige skirt, and holding a draped purple garment in her left arm. Clothing is draped over a chair near her, and a decorative metal pitcher and basin are positioned behind her. In the background, there is a bed, deep green curtains, a decorative frieze above a door, and a cushioned seat with clothes and a hat. The scene suggests a private interior space with classical decor.

artworks.title: La raclee avec des roses (The Thrashing with Roses)
artworks.artist: Antoine Cosme Giraud after Antoine Borel
artworks.description: The image captures two individuals in an ornate interior space with opulent decor. The scene depicts two people on a bed, one leaning over the other. Their upper torsos and part of their legs are visible, both with curly hair in historical styles. Their faces are turned towards each other. One person wears a draped garment, while the other appears more exposed. The room features a canopy bed with curtains, an oval mirror on the wall, and a table with decorative items. A dog rests at the foot of the bed on a cushion. The setting conveys elegance and decadence.

artworks.title: Le bain des pieds (The Foot-Bath)
artworks.artist: Antoine Cosme Giraud after Antoine Borel
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a richly decorated room. The first person, a woman, sits on an upholstered chair with one leg resting in an ornate basin. She appears to be washing or soaking her foot. She gazes towards the other person, with loose, curly hair flowing. She is dressed in a robe that is slightly open at the chest, with fabric draping around her legs. A small animal sits beside her feet. The second person, likely a man, leans forward from behind a room divider. He wears a tricorn hat and long coat, holding the edge of the hat in one hand and offering a small object with the other. The room is elaborate, with intricate moldings, an ornate cabinet or armoire, and a tall candlestick holder on a table. The walls feature detailed patterns, possibly landscapes or relief scenes.

artworks.title: L'Indiscret
artworks.description: The image shows three figures indoors. The figure on the left wears clothing typical of the late 18th century. Their body is mostly visible with their head turned to the side. The second figure is standing to the right, reaching towards a curtain. This person has delicate facial features, elaborate hair, and wears a voluminous gown. The third figure is seated to the right, partially obscured by a curtain, and is partially nude with an arm raised. The room is richly decorated with a canopy bed, ornate wall paneling, and a small table with objects. A small dog is near the second figure's feet. A sculpture is visible above a door in the background.

artworks.title: L'Indiscret
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals in a room. A man is standing, slightly leaning forward toward a woman in front of him. The man wears an 18th-century outfit. The woman is leaning back, with one arm raised, wearing a long dress and a cap. Another woman is seated in a canopied area, partially hidden by drapery she holds, with a small dog nearby. The room is ornately decorated with a patterned carpet and architectural details.

artworks.title: Le paysan mecontent
artworks.description: The image shows four figures gathered around a small table with a white tablecloth under a vine-covered trellis in an outdoor setting. One woman is seated, another man is pouring a drink, and a second man is engaging in conversation with the woman. The figures wear 18th-century European attire. A dog is in the foreground, facing the standing man. The background includes a stone wall with a small opening showing greenery, and part of a thatched roof is visible.

artworks.title: Vous avez la clef, mais il a trouve le serrure
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene inside a room with a canopy bed and open window as a couple stands near the door. The drawing captures an interior setting with rich detail. In the foreground, a luxurious canopy bed draped with curtains holds an occupant peacefully sleeping, surrounded by opulent bedding. Beside the bed stands an open window, revealing hints of greenery outside. Near the door, the composition shows a pair managing a ladder and being surprised by the scene on the bed. The room itself is adorned with finely carved woodwork and the etching is framed with a decorative border featuring fruit and floral motifs. The inclusion of French text at the bottom, "Vous avez la clef... mais il a trouvé la serrure," adds narrative depth. The overall stylistic choice communicates a balance of humor and the aesthetic typical of 18th-century art.

artworks.title: Young Woman with a Rose
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after François Boucher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in green, red, and black on green prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows a partial portrait of a person with delicate facial features, softly arched eyebrows, a small smile, and eyes that are partially closed. They have styled hair with loose curls framing their face, adorned with a rose on the right side. The person is wearing a draped garment with a low neckline, and a rose is placed at the center of their chest. An earring hanging from the left ear is visible. The background features a textured surface with a neutral tone, enclosed within an ornamental border framing the portrait.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Leda
artworks.artist: William Wynne Ryland after François Boucher
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals who are mostly unclothed, with their bodies partially obscured by drapery. They are positioned close together on the ground, with luxurious fabric draped around them. The person on the left is on their knees, with their torso turned toward the viewer, their face lightly resting against the shoulder of the other person. The individual on the right is seated and leaning back slightly, appearing to gesture with their right arm extended upwards. Both have youthful and soft facial features, with curly hair styled close to their heads. Around them are foliage, leaves, branches, and flowers, creating a lush setting. A swan is positioned at their feet. The scene is set against a tapestry of rocky formations covered with plant engravings.
